details: @goparrot-dashboard/app is a dependency-confusion probe: it takes a name in a `@goparrot-dashboard` scope that its publisher created on npm, next to GoParrot's public `@goparrot` scope, so a build that resolves that scope from npm runs its code instead of a private package of the same name. In 0.0.2 a preinstall script runs `node index.js` on npm install, which collects the hostname, the `whoami` user and the working directory, looks up a DNS name built from the user and host names under `iuczektmwpudhwqnsbkgc6m8nx2dgn5vc.oast.fun` with `nslookup`, and sends the same values in a `curl` request to `https://iuczektmwpudhwqnsbkgc6m8nx2dgn5vc.oast.fun/rootxravi-poc`, an interactsh callback host; 0.0.1 and 0.0.3 only print a marker when imported. The npm account devtest91001 published it on 2026-11-01 together with 24 other `@goparrot-dashboard` and `@goparrot-dashboard-api` packages that print the same "rootxravi-poc-security" marker.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
